_comment: Single source of truth for each class's strengths, weaknesses and special ability. Read by the game (class guidebook, class-pick chat message) and used to generate the Player Classes table in README.md: after editing, run ./gradlew generateClassReadme. Write each point as a short phrase without a trailing full stop; the game joins them into sentences. specialOnKey says whether the special is fired with the Power Up key (otherwise it is always active). role and secondaryRole are the party roles (TANK, HEALER, DAMAGE, SUPPORT, UTILITY); roleBlurb and obstacles fill the guidebook's Your role page.

classes.name: Barbarian
cons: Limited vision: fog closes in at about 24 blocks
special: **Rage**: Strength I for 8 seconds, rising to Strength III for 12 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Soak hits up front and smash through what blocks the way
obstacles: **Heavy Boulders**: heave them aside while raging (only you)

classes.name: Bard
special: **Animal Friends**: nearby animals you have charmed with an instrument become companions that follow and fight for you
classes.roleBlurb: Keep the party fighting with songs, inspiration and rest
obstacles: **Singing Doors**: sing them open and skip the tune puzzle (only you)

classes.name: Cleric
cons: Shorter view distance: fog closes in at about 48 blocks
special: **Sanctuary**: a circle mobs won't target, lasting 6 to 15 seconds by rank. From rank II, party members within 8 to 16 blocks share it and regenerate
classes.roleBlurb: Keep the party alive and turn back the unholy
obstacles: **Desecrated Altars**: consecrate them to stop nearby spawners and heal the party (only you)

classes.name: Druid
pros: An extra heart for each tamed animal, up to 5
cons: Gets hungry in the dark (light level 4 or lower)
special: **Wild Shape**: become an animal you have killed and unlocked at an Attunement Table for 15 to 30 seconds by rank. Sneak and press the key to choose the form
classes.roleBlurb: Regrow the party's wounds and take whatever shape the moment needs

classes.name: Fighter
pros: Draws aggro: hostile mobs target a Fighter before other players
cons: No beneficial potions: potions can't be drunk and buffs don't apply, but harmful effects still do
special: **Super Regeneration**: Regeneration V for 4 seconds, up to 10 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Draw the enemy's attention and outlast them
obstacles: **Portcullises**: wedge them open for good (only you)

classes.name: Monk
cons: Reduced damage: 75% unarmored, and less the more armor you wear
Can only attack with a staff or bare fists
special: **Flurry Rush**: blink between the mob you're looking at and hostiles near it for a rapid chain of hits, then blink back. 3 hits on 1 target, up to 10 hits across 5 targets with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Strike fast and reach places nobody else can
obstacles: **Chasms**: leap them and lower the bridge for everyone (only you)

classes.name: Paladin
pros: Unaffected by potions, good or bad (ability effects still apply)
cons: Cannot craft (crafting table, stonecutter, smithing table, loom) or brew potions
Very weak in the Nether: half damage and armor, 20% slower
special: **Divine Judgment**: a beam of holy light strikes the mob you look at within 30 blocks, sets it alight and sends out a shockwave. Undead take 50% more damage. Damage, shockwave and extra beams grow with rank
classes.roleBlurb: Shield your allies with your aura and heal them when it counts
obstacles: **Dread Wards**: walk through and shield allies within 6 blocks from the fear (only you)

classes.name: Ranger
pros: Can zoom in with a bow
special: **Arrow Storm**: hold right click to fire arrows without using ammo. Fire rate, arrow speed and duration grow with rank; no zooming while it runs
classes.roleBlurb: Bring down foes from range and spot what others miss
obstacles: **Hidden doors and traps**: spot them without searching (only you)

classes.name: Rogue
pros: Never needs to eat: food never drains and you never starve, but food doesn't regenerate health either
special: **Vanish**: invisibility for 6 seconds at rank I, up to 15 seconds at rank IV
classes.roleBlurb: Strike from the shadows and open what is locked
obstacles: **Locked chests and doors**: pick them (only you)

classes.name: Necromancer
special: **Raise Dead**: 2 undead allies for 10 seconds, up to 5 stronger undead and a Bone Wyvern for 20 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Walk among the dead and raise an army of your own
obstacles: Lead the party past sleeping crypt undead

classes.name: Warlock
pros: Throws fireballs from an empty hand
cons: Hurt by water and rain: 1 damage every 4 seconds, never below 1 heart
special: **Fire Breath**: hold the key to breathe fire, 8 seconds and 3 blocks at rank I up to 20 seconds and 7 blocks at rank IV
classes.roleBlurb: Blast foes with eldritch fire and curse them for your allies
obstacles: **Fire Curtains**: walk through and douse the brazier (only you)

classes.name: Wizard
cons: Can't wear armor heavier than iron
special: **Arcane Explosion**: a 12-block blast with Resistance V for 2 seconds, up to 72 blocks and 5 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Deal huge area damage and unravel magic

classes.name: Artificer
pros: 25% chance for crafted tools, weapons and armor to come out enchanted
cons: Unaffected by potions: can't drink them and is immune to splash, lingering and tipped-arrow effects (ability effects still apply)
special: **Reinforced Armor**: +8 armor and +4 toughness for 30 seconds
classes.roleBlurb: Craft better gear and keep the party's armour strong

classes.name: Blood Hunter
cons: Can't drop swords (they still drop on death)
special: **Blood Control**: take control of the mob you look at, 8 seconds within 15 blocks at 60% success, up to 20 seconds, 30 blocks and 100% with ranks. Strong mobs resist more, a failure costs the mana and a heart, and bosses can't be controlled. Requires the Identity mod
classes.roleBlurb: Hunt by night and turn your enemies' blood against them
obstacles: **Blood Seals**: open them for 2 hearts (anyone else pays 8, and can split it)

classes.name: Alchemist
pros: Can brew potions only the Alchemist knows
Brewing stands are safe: a stand explodes when its brew finishes if the last player to use it wasn't an Alchemist (stands nobody has used, such as hopper-fed ones, are safe)
cons: Cannot enchant (enchanting table or enchanted books on an anvil)
special: **Transmute**: throw your held potion (or an unstable brew) as a lingering cloud with stronger effects, buffing allies and harming mobs. Bigger and longer-lasting with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Brew clouds that strengthen allies and weaken foes
